meaning: The second queue field is L2-to-DRAM FIFO capacity.
L2 FIFO-full event admission check; an event count, not exclusive stalled core cycles.
Fixed dram_latency is scheduled against core-cycle counter; PS does not halve this delay.
avg_mrq interval: dram_req creation to bank assignment; core-cycle timestamps, not full L2/DRAM round trip.
FRFCFS queue bound and return-queue fullness are distinct constraints.
dram_req timestamp is GPU core-cycle total.
DRAM frequency determines DRAM tick period; core, ICNT, L2 clocks stay fixed.
Printed avg_mrq_latency is total wait divided by selected request count, integer truncated.
